R2AGENT(1)                BSD General Commands Manual               R2AGENT(1)

NAME
     r2agent — Radare2 Agent HTTP Server

SYNOPSIS
     r2agent [-adhsuLjv] [-p port] [-t file]

DESCRIPTION
     An HTTP server providing remote access to Radare2 instances via a RESTful
     API.  It enables remote debugging and analysis of binaries using Radare2.

     -a          Listen for everyone (localhost by default)

     -d          Run in daemon mode (background)

     -h          Show help message

     -s          Run in sandbox mode

     -u          Enable HTTP authorization access

     -t file     User:password authentication file

     -p port     Specify listening port (defaults to 8080)

     -v          Show r2 version information and exit

     -L          List currently loaded r2 sessions and exit

     -j          Output JSON when used with -v or -L (modifier; no effect
                 alone)

ENVIRONMENT
     r2agent does not use any environment variables.

EXAMPLES
     Start r2agent on default port (8080):

       $ r2agent

     Start r2agent on port 9090:

       $ r2agent -p 9090

     Run r2agent in daemon mode:

       $ r2agent -d

     Allow connections from any IP address:

       $ r2agent -a

     Run with authentication enabled:

       $ r2agent -u -t auth.txt

     Show version (text):

       $ r2agent -v

     Show version (JSON):

       $ r2agent -v -j

     List currently loaded sessions (text):

       $ r2agent -L

     List currently loaded sessions (JSON):

       $ r2agent -L -j

SEE ALSO
     radare2(1)

AUTHORS
     Written by pancake <pancake@nopcode.org>.

                                 Jul 10, 2025

help.text:
usage: clang-format-radare2 [-h] [-i] [-n] [-v] [-a]
                            [--clang-format CLANG_FORMAT] [--print-config]
                            [files ...]

Format files using clang-format followed by radare2 indentation rules.

positional arguments:
  files                 Files or directories to format in place.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -i, --in-place        Do nothing, because that's the default behaviour, for
                        muscle memory compatibility reasons with clang-format
  -n, --no-update       Do not modify files; report differences and exit with
                        error if formatting is needed.
  -v, --version         Show the clang-format-radare2 version and exit.
  -a, --auto            Auto mode: ignore provided paths and use the
                        indentation whitelist.
  --clang-format CLANG_FORMAT
                        clang-format executable to use (default: env
                        CLANG_FORMAT or clang-format).
  --print-config        Print the embedded .clang-format configuration to
                        stdout and exit.

--auto.help: Auto mode: ignore provided paths and use the indentation whitelist.

--clang-format.help: clang-format executable to use (default: env CLANG_FORMAT or clang-format).

--disable-check.help: Disable a specific lint check by its ID

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--ignore.help: Ignore files/directories containing this path substring

--in-place.help: Do nothing, because that's the default behaviour, for muscle memory compatibility reasons with clang-format

--list-checks.help: List all available lint check IDs and descriptions

--local.help: Adds support for local/side-by-side installation (sets rpath if needed)

--no-update.help: Do not modify files; report differences and exit with error if formatting is needed.

--nosudo.help: Do not use sudo for install/symstall/uninstall

--print-config.help: Print the embedded .clang-format configuration to stdout and exit.

--project.help: Create a visual studio project and do not build.

--release.help: Set the build as Release (remove debug info)

--shared.help: Link dynamically (shared library) rather than statically

--version.help: Show the clang-format-radare2 version and exit.

-A.help: Run aaa or aaaa after loading each binary (see -C).

-B.help: Define the base address to add the offsets when listing.

-G.help: Run an r2 command on every RCore instance created.

-O.help: Code diffing with opcode bytes only.

-S.help: Sort code diff (name, namelen, addr, size, type, dist) (only for -C or -g).

-T.help: Analyze files in threads (EXPERIMENTAL, 30% faster and crashy).

-b.help: Specify register size for architecture (16 (thumb), 32, 64, etc.).

-binary.help: location of binary to use for clang-format

-e.help: Set eval config var value for all RCore instances.

-f.help: Interpret the input file as a FLIRT 'I.sig' file and dump its signatures.

-g.help: Graph diff of [sym] or functions in [off1,off2].

-iregex.help: custom pattern selecting file paths to reformat (case insensitive, overridden by -regex)

-o.help: Add generated signatures to the specified file. Creates the file if it does not exist.

-p.help: strip the smallest prefix containing P slashes

-regex.help: custom pattern selecting file paths to reformat (case sensitive, overrides -iregex)

-s.help: Compute edit distance (no substitution, Eugene W. Myers O(ND) diff algorithm).

-ss.help: Compute Levenshtein edit distance (substitution is allowed, O(N^2)).

-style.help: formatting style to apply (LLVM, Google, Chromium, Mozilla, WebKit)

-t.help: Set threshold for code diff (default is 70%).
